milestone: Native Engram canonical keys and immutable compressed token map
status: qualified component; full goal remains active

implementation.profile: Architecture-selected V4.1 tokenizer map policy exposed through model adapters. Generic Unicode tables, no model-specific precomputed map.
implementation.normalization: Unicode9 compatibility decomposition and removal of all Mark categories; Unicode17 per-character lowercase; source ASCII whitespace collapse, Unicode whitespace trim and literal U+E000 replacement order. Replacement-containing decoded tokens use raw pieces; empty normalization uses original decoded bytes. Keys are byte-counted and may contain NUL.
implementation.compression: Token-ID ascending first-seen key order, counted-byte hashing and comparison. One owned, budgeted builder allocation; independent immutable model copy bound before backend publication.
implementation.failure: Allocation/budget/configuration failures preserve empty handles. Raw-token mapping validates the entire batch before writes; invalid IDs and prohibited aliases reject atomically. No implicit identity fallback.
implementation.ownership: Builder owns its keys and IDs after vocabulary/document teardown. Model owns copied IDs after builder teardown. No model dependency on tokenizer implementation.

memory.scope: JSON, vocabulary metadata, allocator overhead, row cache, backend and session storage have separate budgets.

independent_reference.method: Unchanged pinned source normalizer and complete token-map function executed with Rust tokenizers0.23.3. Every real canonical key and compressed ID compared. Unicode tables generated separately from hash-pinned official UCD files.
independent_reference.unicode_coverage: Every valid scalar alone and in a context string, plus curated cases. Separate exhaustive diagnostics establish Unicode9 decomposition/mark behavior and Unicode17 lowercase.
independent_reference.immutable_replay: Table and Rust capture replay byte-identically; altered source/data rejected and conflicting reference payload preserved.

validation.sanitizers: ASAN/UBSAN on new C paths; CUDA memcheck including full leaks and initcheck pass. Racecheck limited to bounded unchanged row decoder. Legacy moe_cpu_kernels and CUDA translation units use normal builds.
validation.qwen27: Fresh strict CUDA comparison: 192/192 sampled token IDs, 8/8 first IDs, zero count mismatches; 147/147 word prefix matches.
validation.integrity: Source/reference/probe/binary hashes checked throughout; four user binaries preserved.

not_claimed: Native text encoding or streaming multi-token decoding
Request-local mapped history transactions, reset, rewind or resumed full-model execution
vLLM parity, serving concurrency or new ARM/Metal coverage
